story.title: The Fox and the Red Hat
story.summary: A five-page test story in flat 1960s screen-print style: a child loses a red hat in the wind and follows a fox's paw prints through the snow.

slot.label: The child
slot.description: A child about 3 to 10 years old, the main character on every page
slot.outfit: a mustard-yellow puffy winter coat, teal trousers, red mittens and red boots

styleWords: flat mid-century screen-print: bold flat colour in teal, coral red, mustard and navy, thick navy outlines, halftone-dot shading, slightly misregistered colour
